description: 根据用户提供的三视图中左侧 FRONT 角色编辑的正面半身插画，银白与浅绿长发、黑框眼镜及绿蓝星球肩饰。
background: 不透明白色背景；生成像素存在轻微近白色变化，四角各通道为 253–255。
fallback_reason: 首次透明提取与一次定向背景移除均由内置工具返回 RGB 棋盘格图，无真实 alpha。主任务随后授权采用白色背景版本用于白色欢迎区。未用 Python 或其他工具抠图，也未通过转为 RGBA 伪称透明。
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Edit target: Image 1 is the finished front-facing half-body character. Image 2 is the original reference sheet; its left FRONT figure is the identity reference.
Replace ONLY the entire gray checkerboard background in Image 1 with a perfectly clean, flat, uniform pure white background (#FFFFFF, RGB 255 255 255). The output is intentionally FULLY OPAQUE on a WHITE canvas. There must be no checkerboard pattern or gray marks anywhere in the empty areas, including all gaps between strands of hair, antenna stems, and planet rings. No texture, gradients, shadows, vignette, borders or scenery in the white background.
Keep the illustrated character unchanged: same face and black-framed glasses, pale lavender-blue eyes, silver-white short layered hair and long pale green tipped side locks, original green head stems with small yellow star, translucent green and blue planet shoulder ornaments, original hair clip, original loose white top and garment artwork, original gentle expression and relaxed pose. Retain the same delicate anime linework, colors, proportions and current waist-level crop. Keep the complete head ornaments visible inside the canvas.
One front-facing character centered on the square white canvas. Preserve existing clothing coverage. No additional words, labels, logos, branding, objects or UI. Do not redraw, redesign or invent the character.

generation_steps.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve
Asset type: transparent-background anime character half-body illustration for the right side of a Windows application workbench, also usable as a cropped avatar.
Input images: the supplied character turnaround sheet is the identity and clothing reference. Edit and extract ONLY the leftmost character labelled FRONT. SIDE and BACK figures, labels, frame, white paper and all sheet elements are not part of the output.
Primary request: create one high-fidelity clean cutout of that same FRONT character, front-facing, centered, from the full topmost antenna and star down to the waist. Use a genuinely transparent RGBA background, not a white background or a drawn checkerboard.
Identity invariants: retain the recognizable silver-white short layered hair around the head and the two very long side locks, soft pale mint-green coloring toward the long hair ends, the black-framed glasses, pale lavender-blue eyes, the fine green antenna-like stems over the head with the small yellow star, the translucent green and blue planet-like ornaments at the shoulders, the small original hair clip, and the original loose white top and its existing collar, sleeve and garment artwork details. Preserve the original face, proportions, linework, palette and delicate soft cel shading. Do not redesign or invent a new character.
Composition: one figure only, exactly front-facing with a gentle calm expression and relaxed neutral posture. Keep the entire head, hair tuft, thin green stems, star, both planet shoulder ornaments and the widest visible side locks inside the canvas, with comfortable transparent padding above and to both sides. The lower torso and relaxed arms end naturally at the waist-level bottom crop; no legs. Keep the characteristic pale green long hair ends visible near the lower sides when possible while maintaining the recognizable hair silhouette. Portrait-friendly centered half-body composition on a square canvas.
Style/medium: faithful polished 2D anime illustration matching the supplied design sheet, crisp anti-aliased edges suitable for compositing over a pale desktop UI.
Constraints: maintain existing clothing coverage and the original costume; no new suggestive pose or body emphasis. Retain only original garment artwork that already belongs to the reference; do not add any new lettering, labels, branding or logos.
Avoid: environment, scenic background, solid backdrop, drop shadow behind the figure, frame, borders, mockup, UI, multiple views, additional people, props, cut-off head ornaments, new text, FRONT/SIDE/BACK labels, watermark.
generation_steps.outcome: Discarded: RGB with painted checkerboard, no alpha channel.

generation_steps.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction
Edit target: Image 1 is the prepared front-facing half-body character. Image 2 is the original supplied character sheet and is only an identity reference for the left FRONT character.
Remove the entire gray checkerboard background from Image 1 and return a PNG cutout with a REAL TRANSPARENT ALPHA CHANNEL. All pixels outside the character must be transparent (alpha 0), including the spaces between the long hair strands, antenna stems and planet rings. A painted checkerboard is not transparency. Do not draw any background at all.
Preserve the character in Image 1 unchanged: same face, glasses, silver-white layered hair and long mint-tipped side locks, lavender-blue eyes, green head stems and yellow star, blue and green planet shoulder ornaments, white loose top, gentle front-facing pose and waist crop. Keep her original outfit and all identifying details faithful to the FRONT design in Image 2.
Keep every head ornament fully visible with clear top padding. Do not add text, labels, borders, a ground shadow or any other element. Keep the same clean delicate anime linework and smooth anti-aliased cutout edge. No UI or scene.
This is strictly transparent background removal; do not replace the checkerboard with a solid color, do not leave checkerboard visible anywhere, and do not redesign the person.
generation_steps.outcome: Discarded: RGB with painted checkerboard, no alpha channel.
